hero_kpi_rationale: Centrica has set an ambitious target of 48% women by 2030, reflecting its commitment to diversity and inclusion. Currently at 30%, this progression demonstrates a structural and measurable commitment to talent transformation.

kpis.name: Women in Total Workforce
kpis.explanation: Percentage of women across the company's total workforce, reflecting commitment to diversity.
kpis.description: The percentage of women in the total workforce is 30% in 2023, unchanged from 2022. The company aims to reach 48% by 2030, aligning with UK working-age demographics according to Census 2021.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company, including all hierarchical levels.
kpis.description: Total headcount (excluding Spirit Energy) is 20,619 employees in 2023, comprising 6,221 women and 14,398 men. Headcount remains stable despite sector challenges.
kpis.signal: Stable workforce reflecting a human resources retention strategy

kpis.name: Apprentices Hired
kpis.explanation: Number of apprentices hired annually as part of the talent development program.
kpis.description: Centrica has committed to hiring 3,500 apprentices and providing career development opportunities to underrepresented groups by 2030, with a milestone of 2,000 apprentices by end-2025.

kpis.name: Ethnically Diverse Workforce
kpis.explanation: Percentage of employees from ethnically diverse backgrounds across the total workforce.
kpis.description: 15% of the total workforce is ethnically diverse in 2023. The company targets 18% by 2030, reflecting Census 2021 data for working-age populations.

kpis.name: Employees with Disabilities
kpis.explanation: Percentage of employees with disabilities within the total workforce.
kpis.description: 3% of the total workforce reports a disability in 2023. Centrica is committed to achieving 20% representation by 2030, requiring significant improvement.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 3.67 GBp in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.237 Bn GBp in the latest year.

risks.title: Energy Transition and Gradual Phase-Out of Gas
risks.score_rationale: Risk highlighted centrally in climate scenario analysis with strong language ('material dependencies', 'gradual phase-out of natural gas'); trend stable compared to prior year (2022 analysis repeated); environmental/regulatory transition category carries high weight in this sector.

risks.title: Government and Regulatory Intervention in Energy
risks.score_rationale: Risk listed first among principal risks ('Principal Risks and Uncertainties') with explicit mention across multiple report sections; language refers to potential interventions in energy markets; regulatory category has high weighting; trend stable.

risks.title: Cyber Risk and IT System Security
risks.score_rationale: Cyber risk explicitly named among principal risks related to social and technological challenges; cybersecurity category receives high weighting in analysis; mentioned centrally in the report; trend stable.

risks.title: Physical Climate Risks to Group Assets
risks.score_rationale: Risk assessed through warming scenarios ranging from 1.5°C to 4°C with moderate language ('potential impact'); asset impairment analysis updated in 2023, indicating stable trend; positioned mid-report in TCFD section.

risks.title: Gas Asset Impairment in a Net Zero Scenario
risks.score_rationale: Asset impairment risk explicitly re-evaluated in 2023 based on 1.5°C scenarios with direct language ('most exposed assets were our gas assets'); trend increased as analysis horizon extended; positioned centrally in strategic section of report.

risks.title: Inflation and Cost of Living Pressures on Customers
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly named among principal risks related to social issues; language remains descriptive without extreme urgency; trend stable; positioned mid-report.

risks.title: Human Resources and Safety Risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk listed first among principal risks ('People, Safety and Operational Asset Integrity'), giving it top priority; language is moderate, focused on culture and well-being; trend stable; category has standard weighting.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents. The company does not position AI as a strategic lever in its 2023 report.
evidence: No reference to AI, algorithms, or automation tools in excerpts from the annual report
